Question: My sister-in-law experience a dream about wife that they both are standing at the top of very hight clif and my wife is advising her sister not to move an inch otherwise they would fall. But suddently my wife herself fall from that cliff. My sister-in-law expereince this dream twice and on both occasions my wife falls from the height. Answer ID: 23378 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1301/985/H=1431) It is feared that your wife will meet some loss as a result of the carelessness of your sister-in-law. She should try to gain the highest rank of taqwa and modesty. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
